description: Type the missing-app answer on get/patch/remove Android apps. Firebase Management returns HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'The caller does not have permission' (not 404) for an app id that does not exist, so a missing app surfaced as the generic Forbidden.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The Android app does not exist. Firebase answers HTTP 403 'The caller does not have permission' for a missing app id instead of 404.

message.includes: The caller does not have permission
